clips.title: The story
paras: Talvash del Kissel is a down-on-his-luck gnome jeweler who fled the fall of Gnomeregan and now resides in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. Plagued by debt and persistent rumors following the loss of his home, he seeks capable adventurers to help recover lost treasures and restore shattered relics. His keen eye for precious gems and ancient baubles makes him a valuable contact for those plumbing the depths of Uldaman.

Once a respected jeweler in the technological heart of Gnomeregan, Talvash saw his livelihood obliterated alongside his home when the troggs overran the underground city. Escaping with the surviving refugees to the dwarven capital of Ironforge, he set up camp in the Mystic Ward. Unfortunately, relocation did not treat him kindly. Rumors of questionable dealings and unpaid obligations quickly piled up, sinking the craftsman into deep financial distress. Unable to rebuild his trade through conventional means, Talvash relies on freelance adventurers to retrieve lost assets and salvage his ruined reputation.

Despite his misfortunes, Talvash has lost none of his gem-cutting precision or appraisal acumen. When explorers in the Badlands uncover an ancient, shattered necklace deep within the Titan vault of Uldaman, Talvash proves to be one of the few craftsmen in the Eastern Kingdoms capable of understanding its intricate enchantments. Restoring such power requires rare components and painstaking labor, but Talvash is eager to ply his trade—both to clear his debts and to prove his enduring skill.
